title: Email Verifier — request body
description: Body for POST /v2/acts/sumitr_mardy~email-verifier/run-sync-get-dataset-items. Mirrors the Actor's own input schema; verified field-by-field against it.

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Addresses to verify. One result record is returned per entry, in no guaranteed order — match results back by `email` or `normalized_email`, never by position.

emailFileUrl.title: Email file URL
emailFileUrl.description: Public URL of a .txt (one address per line) or .csv file. Every email-shaped token in the file is picked up. Used in addition to `emails`, not instead of it.

concurrency.title: SMTP concurrency
concurrency.description: Parallel SMTP handshakes. Addresses are grouped by domain first, so this is really 'domains in flight'. Raising it speeds up lists with many distinct domains and does nothing for a list concentrated on a few.

smtpTimeoutMs.title: SMTP timeout (ms)
smtpTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for each SMTP reply before giving up on a host.

verbose.title: Verbose output
verbose.description: Adds a `raw` object per record with per-layer detail (MX list, probe codes, raw SMTP text). Off by default to keep records small. Useful when investigating one address, wasteful on a list.
